description: This file defines a custom exception class InvalidURLException within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin, used for handling invalid URL errors for services like YouTube, Vimeo, and Dailymotion.

classes.name: InvalidURLException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception, used for signaling invalid URL errors in the Buzz plugin.

methods.name: invalidYouTubeURLProvided
methods.description: Returns an instance of InvalidURLException with a message indicating an invalid YouTube URL.

methods.name: invalidVimeoURLProvided
methods.description: Returns an instance of InvalidURLException with a message indicating an invalid Vimeo URL.

methods.name: invalidDailymotionURLProvided
methods.description: Returns an instance of InvalidURLException with a message indicating an invalid Dailymotion URL.
